You're past the halfway point of the hardest season he runs. July in Texas means he's been hauling, competing, sweating, and doing it again the next weekend.

A horse that's been working this hard since spring without a check is almost always carrying something. You might not see it yet. He might not show it until the run that matters.

Dr. Leo is scheduling performance horse visits across DFW and North Texas now. Mobile — he comes to your barn, your arena, your schedule. No extra stress on a horse that's already been hauled hard.

The back half of summer is still full of runs worth making. Make sure your horse is ready for them.

Book now — shortgochiro.com or (406) 799-3369.
